title: Aoyagi Toya — A Brief Nap〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks for all your hard work today, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Likewise. It's been quite a long day. We practiced in the morning, went to school, sang in an event and practiced individually once that was all done.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah...
But I'm so glad we won that event.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We just barely got a decision in our favor, but we really gave it everything we had. Also...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
He was. Akito's been so dependable as of late.
He's been giving off this powerful aura that seems to declare, “I'm going to win no matter what.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I suspect he's practicing with Ken right now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Right...
He's been looking really exhausted lately. Is he going to be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I think so.
According to Akito...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ken told him to relax and sing from his heart more.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He understood what Ken was saying, but he had trouble putting that into practice.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thing just aren't that easy...
I'm not even sure I understand how to achieve the thing I've been assigned...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Me neither.
Just as with Akito, we won't achieve our assignments overnight.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An was saying the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you for seeing us out, Shiraishi. We really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's totally fine since it's just to the front of the cafe!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Is Shinonome staying again today?
He's been working so hard lately...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah... The other day, I got to see Akito and my dad singing together for like a split second...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It reminded me of when he was performing in events when I was little...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's been so long since I've seen him so pumped up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
After all this time too...
Uncle Taiga actually popped into my head.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Would I be able to stand up against Ken and all his might...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (When we battled against Taiga, I couldn't do anything... He squashed me like a bug.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(And Ken was Taiga's partner.
Even if it isn't as a battle, singing with him one on one must feel so tense...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I can't begin to imagine how difficult that is.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And in Akito's case, it's not just that there's a massive skill gap between them...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I hope that isn't making him feel more anxious...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(No, what am I saying...?
I'm sure he'll figure out a way like he always does.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito always knows how to produce good results.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And when he does, we'll have to figure out a way to perform at his level...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Let's keep doing our best, Azusawa.
We're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND. Together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's do everything we can, Aoyagi!
